passes.name: ownership and call graph
evidence: Authored webhook code still delegates through EveChannelDispatch to the injected Eve send operation.
Pinned and installed Eve still own deliver or run, resumeHook, startWorkflowPreferLatest, session Workflow and turn child dispatch.
Hosted Workflow run fingerprints remained bound to Eve-owned Workflow deployments.
No app-owned Workflow client, wrapper, queue fallback, mirrored service or generated-output patch was added.

passes.name: Effect quality
evidence: The hosted slice changed no runtime boundary or provider client.
Existing ingress Schema decoding, branded semantic identities, safe tagged errors, Config.schema and explicit Layers remain intact.
No unsafe cast, manual object reader, instanceof policy or Effect retry was added.
Provider and SDK clients remain private to their existing adapters.

passes.name: boundary and lifecycle correctness
evidence: Preview and both Production direct journeys record SendAccepted before 202.
Cross-deployment Preview continuity matched the existing safe session fingerprint; a fallback new run was not accepted as resume proof.
Exact Sendblue redelivery produced zero second Workflow and outbound result in Preview and Production.
The replacement exercise remained attempt one and the Production Photon exact duplicate oracle remained inconclusive rather than overstated.

passes.name: adversarial verification
evidence: The initial two-callback Preview fan-out and the dirty Production candidate are retained as rejected evidence.
READY, local Build Output, waitUntil, aggregate green tests, and historical or fallback runs were not promoted into hosted proof.
Authenticated Vercel functions, Workflow CLI, bounded logs, provider APIs/dashboard, handset and final restoration readbacks own the external claims.
The complete repository verification passed after focused packet, docs, verification, boundary, Effect, skills, authority and controls gates.

passes.name: documentation authority and closeout
evidence: The task ledger, active plan, verification router, hosted detail and successor packets agree on accepted Preview and inconclusive combined Production.
Earlier blocked and local-audit packets are lifecycle-superseded with explicit successors rather than silently rewritten.
Sendblue and hashed Photon topology match captured before-state; Production and Preview aliases match rollback identities.
One-run external authority is consumed, no credentials or message content are retained, and no standing deploy, provider, promotion, rollback or merge authority is claimed.

preAuditCorrection.finding: The first focused verification-policy check rejected an unsupported command receipt outcome in the new Production packet.
preAuditCorrection.action: Changed only the command receipt outcome to the supported blocked classification while preserving the packet's top-level inconclusive result.
preAuditCorrection.recheck: Focused verification policy passed before the terminal audit started.

rollback.providerState: Captured sole Sendblue callback and two unchanged hashed Photon callbacks.

limitations: Preview deployment replacement did not force a step retry; every observed step remained attempt one.
Combined Production remains inconclusive on the candidate-specific Photon exact duplicate oracle.
No numeric Photon webhook response deadline was available.
External state can change after the final readback.
nonClaims: The audit does not prove exactly-once execution, universal availability, every termination mode, or future provider and plan behavior.
The audit grants no standing deployment, provider, credential, message, promotion, rollback, push, merge or release authority.
No raw Workflow run ID, hook token, provider payload, phone identity, message content or credential is retained.
